exact_text:
When –DMI crosses above +DMI, as it did on October 8, a
sell signal is generated.
added_conditions: sell signal is generated when –DMI crosses above +DMI

exact_text:
I don’t want to see –DMI
cross over +DMI — ever. If it does, I exit as quickly as possible.
added_conditions: exit when –DMI crosses over +DMI while long; the reverse holds for a short position

exact_text:
A positive divergence in MACD occurs when a security makes a new low
but the MACD histogram fails to confirm that low
added_conditions: positive divergence: price makes a new low while the MACD histogram fails to confirm that low, indicating sellers are weakening

exact_text: sellers are exhausted and buyers are preparing to turn prices around
added_conditions: positive divergence: price falls to a new low while stochastics traces a higher trough; negative divergence: price reaches a new high while stochastics traces a lower high

exact_text: 3. Exit after stochastics reaches the opposite zone.
added_conditions: used to profit from short-term swings in a trading range; exit when the oscillator reaches the opposite zone

exact_text: Begin your search by looking at the top ten performing industry groups
added_conditions: start from the top ten performing industry groups and drill down to trending securities; short candidates come from industry groups in the bottom 10 percent of performance breaking into new lows

exact_text:
Stochastics flashes a buy signal when the signal line crosses above the
moving average from an oversold level.
added_conditions: entry in a trading range; buy when the stochastics signal line crosses above its moving average from an oversold level

exact_text:
The target profit in trading ranges is just the opposite side of the trading
range.
added_conditions: risk level is placed slightly below the support level

exact_text:
If the Federal Reserve raises interest rates,
the dollar is likely to strengthen because investors seek out high yields on
their investments.
added_conditions: central bank short-term interest rate changes affect demand for the currency; rate cuts reduce investor willingness to lend to that country

exact_text:
Another application of relative strength analysis is to compare industry
groups to the overall market.
added_conditions: stocks within a hot industry group tend to rise together; stocks in out-of-favor groups tend to fall together

added_parameters.name: industry group share of stock performance

exact_text:
After a company has reported earnings, you can generally swing trade the
stock, because the bad or good news about earnings is out.
added_conditions: avoid trading before earnings reports because price can gap on the announcement; trade after the report once the news is out

added_parameters.name: earnings date estimation
added_parameters.value: add three months to the last report date
